summary: Full backend health scan: 24/24 pytest tests passed against public URL. Verified public jobs API (list/pagination/filters/sort/single/404), auth guard (401), authenticated flows via seeded Mongo session, AI resume optimization one-page constraint (P0), AI cover letter word cap, and job ingestion endpoints. No 500s observed. ObjectId serialization is safe (all queries use projection {_id:0}).
passed_tests: TestHealth: api root, api health, public health
TestPublicJobs: list basic, pagination, remote filter, source filter, query+sort, get by id, 404, sources, companies

TestResumeOptimization: optimized resume respects one-page constraint (orig 16 lines/102 words/705 chars -> opt 16 lines/100 words/687 chars), preserves EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION/SKILLS headers, keeps bullet style, no code fences
TestCoverLetter: cover letter returned within word cap (<=500)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~4315 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline and should be modularized (routes/services/models split) in a future refactor.

optimize_resume: the _too_long() retry runs at most once; if the LLM's second attempt still exceeds original length the endpoint returns the too-long output without a final hard truncation. Consider a deterministic fallback (e.g. truncate to orig_lines / orig_words) after the retry to guarantee the P0 constraint even on worst-case LLM outputs.
generate_cover_letter accesses user_doc['name'] without null-check; if the users doc is missing this raises TypeError -> 500. Use user_doc.get('name', user.name) for safety.
public /jobs/ingest is unauthenticated and can be triggered by anyone - consider rate limiting or auth to prevent abuse of upstream scraping.
test_credentials: Seeded and cleaned up: user_id=qa-user-1, session_token=qa-session-token-123 (deleted after run)
seed_data_creation: Autouse session fixture in test_health_scan.py seeds users/user_sessions/user_profiles for qa-user-1 and deletes all three docs on teardown. Cleanup verified post-run (users/sessions/profiles all absent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_health_scan.py; the autouse fixture seeds and cleans a QA session via Mongo. BASE_URL comes from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 24 backend tests currently green. If retesting resume optimization, note the LLM occasionally hovers close to the char limit but stayed under original for this run (16/100/687 vs 16/102/705).
rca of the issue: No bug reproduced. P0 one-page resume constraint holds for the tested input; the _strip_fences + _too_long retry logic works. Minor risk noted above: no hard fallback if second LLM call also over-shoots.
